items.title: Peab builds homes in Visby
items.summary: Peab builds homes in Visby 2026-09-22 08:00:00 Peab has been commissioned to build 40 new homes in Visby. The customer is Gotlandshem and the contract is worth SEK 114 million. Peab has been working on the demolition and reconstruction of the Riggen Block in Gråbo in southern Visby since the autumn of 2024. Now that the zoning plan for the third phase has been approved, the project can proceed with an additional 40 homes. It entails building six rows of terraced houses with homes that have four rooms and a kitchen. The living space of each home will be just under 100 m2. items.title: Peab builds production and office space in Landskrona
items.summary: Peab builds production and office space in Landskrona 2026-09-17 08:00:00 Peab has been commissioned to renovate and extend production and office space in Landskrona. The customer is Hitachi Energy Sweden AB and the contract is worth SEK 349 million. The project comprises renovating and extending an existing building in eastern Landskrona, just north of the train station. The total area is around 24,000 m2, of which 18,000 m2 is production halls and 6,000 m2 is offices. The project will be implemented according to Miljöbyggnad Silver 4.0 for Renovation certification. items.title: Peab builds homes and retail space in Umeå
items.summary: Peab builds homes and retail space in Umeå 2026-09-16 08:00:00 Peab has been commissioned to build housing and retail space in the new city district Hagaliden in Umeå. The customers are Bonava Hagamarket AB and Bonava Sverige AB and the total contract amount is SEK 121 million. The project consists of two separate turnkey contracts. One of the contracts comprises the construction of a grocery store for Coop where Bonava Hagamarket AB is the customer. The second contract is for Brf Motorn where Bonava Sverige AB is the customer. items.title: Peab renovates the town hall in Botkyrka
items.summary: Peab renovates the town hall in Botkyrka 2026-09-15 08:00:00 Peab has been commissioned to renovate the town hall in Botkyrka. The customer is Botkyrka Municipality and the contract is worth SEK 440 million. The renovation includes demolishing and rebuilding existing premises, new technical installations, a new facade and refurbishing the entrance and common areas. The town hall is approximately 13,500 m2 and comprises ten floors. "We're proud to have been entrusted with the renovation of Botkyrka Town Hall. items.title: Peab signs framework contract for water and sewage work in Örnsköldsvik
items.summary: Peab signs framework contract for water and sewage work in Örnsköldsvik 2026-09-03 08:00:00 Peab has been awarded an eight-year framework contract by Miljö och Vatten i Örnsköldsvik AB (Miva) for construction work in water and sewage in Örnsköldsvik Municipality. A contract worth SEK 100 million will be order registered in the third quarter of 2026. The framework contract covers groundwork projects regarding new construction, renewal, repair and maintenance of the public water and sewage plant in Örnsköldsvik Municipality. items.title: Peab builds new central kitchen in Torsby
items.summary: Peab builds new central kitchen in Torsby 2026-09-02 08:00:00 Peab has been commissioned to build a new central kitchen at Stjerne School in Torsby. The customer is Torsby Municipality and the contract is worth SEK 111 million. The project comprises building a new central kitchen in a 1,500 m2 extension. The kitchen will be dimensioned to handle preparing around 2,500 portions of food daily and will also have a standby function in the form of an island operation.
